decision: Accept the Glen/Norton creep implementation if every pre-declared threshold below is met; otherwise report honest FAIL per item.
alternatives: A: Norton dashpot in series with the bond spring + Kelvin branch + Rabotnov damage (implemented)
B: Maxwell-Wiechert Prony-series bond (already in ice_bond_viscoelastic) - linear, cannot give sigma^n
C: empirical strain-time fits (no constitutive law) - rejected: not extrapolable in stress/temperature
hypothesis: A bonded-sphere DEM with a Norton bond dashpot reproduces (i) the Norton exponent n, (ii) the three creep stages, (iii) F(t) ~ t^(-1/(n+1)) at constant penetration for n=3, (iv) Arrhenius A(T).
baseline_control: maxwell_wiechert linear bond as the n=1 control
stopping_rule: Stop when the stress exponent sweep, the three-stage run, the plate relaxation sweep and the temperature table have all been executed once at their declared resolutions; no re-tuning of thresholds after seeing results.

confounders: lattice discretisation factor on the absolute rate

repetition_rationale: Deterministic model - no sampling noise; the only stochastic element is a fixed-seed rotation matrix. Repetition is replaced by resolution studies (three fit windows, three lattice sizes 3^3/4^3/6^3, 200-2000 steps).
analysis: least-squares log-log fits with R2, relative errors against closed forms, window sensitivity reported for every fitted exponent
declared_before_runs: thresholds fixed before the validation driver was first executed
